description:
## Summary

1. Goal: add **Planning** and **Follow-up** views (beyond the existing Kanban) so users/managers can track task status, priorities, due dates, and upcoming work.
2. Built `planning.js` store with getters for `priorityGroups`, `metrics`, `needsAttention`, `boardProgress`, and `activityFeed`, sourced from `/api/chats/search` scoped by date range.
3. Switched loading from an up-front "fetch all pages" loop to incremental **infinite scroll** (page 1 on filter change, next page on scroll), with a `Showing X of Y` counter.
4. Fixed a range-filter issue (date-range-only searches rejected as empty query) and a **page-1-only** aggregation bug.
5. Resolved the runtime error `Cannot create property 'hasMore' on boolean 'true'` — caused by a dropped `state` argument in `mutations.setHasMore(...)` in `fetchPage()`.

## Direct Recommendation

Move **all dataset-wide aggregation and filtering to the backend** behind a small `/api/planning/*` surface. Today the store paginates `/api/chats/search` and then computes `metrics`, `boardProgress`, `needsAttention`, `priorityGroups` and `activityFeed` **from only the loaded pages**, so every number is wrong as soon as there is more than one page. The fix is a task-scoped query endpoint (paginated + filtered + sorted + group counts) plus one dashboard endpoint that returns the aggregates computed over the **entire** filtered dataset.

---

## 1. Why the current client-side computation is incorrect

| UI element | Current source | Problem with pagination | Must move to backend? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metrics.total / done / overdue …` | `filteredTasks` = loaded pages only | Shows ~100, not real total; every % is wrong | ✅ Yes |
| `priorityGroups[].length` (group badges) | grouped loaded pages | Undercounts each priority group | ✅ Yes (`group_counts`) |
| `boardProgress` % | aggregated loaded pages | Percentages drift as you scroll | ✅ Yes |
| `needsAttention` | filtered loaded pages | A page‑5 overdue task never shows | ✅ Yes (severity‑ordered) |
| `activityFeed` | `task.updatedAt` + `users[0]` as actor | Fabricated actor/action; no real event | ✅ Yes (event log) |
| Board / assignee / text filters | client-side over loaded pages | Matching task on page 5 is invisible | ✅ Yes |
| Global sort (priority → due → manual) | client sort of loaded pages | Order breaks across page boundaries | ✅ Yes |
| `Y` in “Showing X of Y” | `response.total` from `/chats/search` | Counts templates + non-task chats | ✅ Yes (task-scoped total) |
| overdueness / `days_until_due` | recomputed per component, per browser | Timezone & date-string drift between views | ✅ Yes (once, server-side) |

> **Rule:** anything the user reads as a *number about the whole board* must be aggregated server-side. Anything that is *per-row formatting* may stay on the client.

---

## 2. Endpoint overview

| Method | Path | Purpose | Consumed by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/planning/tasks/query` | Paginated, filtered, sorted task rows + group counts + total | Planning list, infinite scroll |
| `POST` | `/api/planning/dashboard` | Metrics, board progress, attention queue, activity, priority counts | Follow-up view |
| `PATCH` | `/api/planning/tasks/{task_id}` | Update priority / due_date / status / progress / assignees / sort_index | Task detail panel |
| `POST` | `/api/planning/tasks/reorder` | Persist manual ordering (bulk) | Drag reorder |
| `GET` | `/api/planning/activity` | Standalone activity feed (paged) | Activity panel (optional) |

The two `POST` endpoints share one request object: **`PlanningQuery`**.

---

## 3. Shared request object — `PlanningQuery`

### Semantics

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `range.field` | `'updated_at' \| 'due_date' \| 'created_at'` | Which date the range applies to. Default `updated_at` (matches today). Use `due_date` when the filter means “work windows”. |
| `range.from` / `range.to` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Inclusive window |
| `boards[]` | string | Filter by board title |
| `assignees[]` | string | Task has **any** of these assignees |
| `priorities[]` | `high\|medium\|low` | |
| `statuses[]` | `todo\|doing\|onhold\|done\|rejected` | |
| `search` | string | Matches name / description / column |
| `attention_only` | bool | Only overdue / due-today / unassigned-high |
| `include_done` | bool | Default `true` |
| `include_templates` | bool | Default `false` (templates always dropped) |
| `project_ids[]` | string | Scope |
| `group_by` | `'priority' \| 'status' \| 'board' \| null` | What `group_counts` are keyed by |
| `page` / `page_size` | int | Offset pagination, `page_size` ≤ 100 |
| `sort.field` | `sort_index \| priority \| due_date \| updated_at` | |
| `sort.dir` | `asc \| desc` | |

```js src/api/model/PlanningQuery.js
/**
 * Planning Query
 *
 * Shared request model for /api/planning/tasks/query and /api/planning/dashboard.
 * All dataset-wide filtering and sorting happens on the backend, so the UI always
 * shows correct totals regardless of how many pages have been scrolled.
 */
export class PlanningQuery {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.range = {
      field: options.range?.field || 'updated_at',
      from: options.range?.from || null,
      to: options.range?.to || null
    }
    this.boards = options.boards || null
    this.assignees = options.assignees || null
    this.priorities = options.priorities || null
    this.statuses = options.statuses || null
    this.search = options.search || ''
    this.attention_only = options.attention_only ?? false
    this.include_done = options.include_done ?? true
    this.include_templates = options.include_templates ?? false
    this.project_ids = options.project_ids || null
    this.group_by = options.group_by || 'priority'

    this.page = Math.max(1, options.page || 1)
    this.page_size = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, options.page_size || 50))

    this.sort = {
      field: options.sort?.field || 'priority',
      dir: options.sort?.dir || 'asc'
    }
  }

  setFilter(key, value) {
    if (key in this) this[key] = value
    return this
  }

  setRange(field, from, to) {
    this.range = { field, from, to }
    return this
  }

  resetPage() {
    this.page = 1
    return this
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      range: this.range.from || this.range.to ? this.range : undefined,
      boards: this.boards || undefined,
      assignees: this.assignees || undefined,
      priorities: this.priorities || undefined,
      statuses: this.statuses || undefined,
      search: this.search || undefined,
      attention_only: this.attention_only || undefined,
      include_done: this.include_done,
      include_templates: this.include_templates,
      project_ids: this.project_ids || undefined,
      group_by: this.group_by,
      page: this.page,
      page_size: this.page_size,
      sort: this.sort
    }
  }

  clone() {
    return new PlanningQuery(this.toJSON())
  }

  static fromJSON(json) {
    return new PlanningQuery(json)
  }
}

export default PlanningQuery
```

## 7. Activity event sourcing (open decision)

`activityFeed` currently fakes the actor from `users[0]`. A real feed needs a source. Three options, cheapest first:

| Option | Source | Effort | Fidelity |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Derive from `Chat.history` (`ChatHistoryEntry`) snapshots | Low | Medium — time + summary, weak on actor/field |
| B | Derive from `Message.meta_data` (tool/lifecycle events already persisted) | Low–medium | Medium — great for agent actions |
| C | **Write a lightweight `planning_events` entry on every metadata update** | Medium | High — actor, field, from→to, timestamp |

**Recommendation: C.** Emit an event inside the same handler that persists `priority/due_date/status/progress/assignees/sort_index`. This is the only way to distinguish *user* vs *agent* actors (`actor_type`) and to show `from_value → to_value`, which the UI already wants for the timeline.

---

## 8. Frontend integration (what changes in `planning.js`)

| Current (client-computed) | Replace with |
|---|---|
| `loadTasks` / `fetchPage` hitting `/chats/search` | `PlanningQuery` → `/api/planning/tasks/query` |
| `metrics`, `boardProgress`, `needsAttention`, `activityFeed` getters | State filled from `/api/planning/dashboard` |
| `totalCount` from `response.total` | `response.total` (now task-scoped) |
| `priorityGroups` counts for badges | `group_counts` from query response |
| `updatePriority/DueDate/Status/Progress/toggleAssignee` | `PATCH /api/planning/tasks/{id}` |
| `reorderTasks` (N parallel calls) | single `POST /api/planning/tasks/reorder` |

`loadNextPage()` guard, `loadToken` stale-discard and the `Showing X of Y` counter all stay exactly as designed — only their data source changes.
